name: daily_vps_digest
prompt: Run a system health check: 1) `free -h` and `df -h` for memory and disk usage. 2) Check Docker containers using `docker ps -a --format 'table {{.Names}}	{{.Status}}	{{.Ports}}'`. Specifically confirm if the Portainer container is healthy and running, and flag any containers that are stopped or restarting. 3) Summarize the findings in a concise, structured status report with green/yellow/red indicators.
